artifacts.summary: Nine named theorems in FormalSystem/Metalogic/Independence/ZTimeSharpness.lean proving Axiom.prior_UZ and Axiom.z1 are not valid at FrameClass.Base, hence not at any class strictly below .ZTime, making the .ZTime row of Axiom.minFrameClass proved-minimal rather than cited.

completion_data.completion_summary: Proved the minimality half of Axiom.minFrameClass's .ZTime tag: the new module FormalSystem/Metalogic/Independence/ZTimeSharpness.lean carries nine sorry-free theorems refuting Axiom.prior_UZ and Axiom.z1 at the frame level on the translation frame over any densely ordered duration group, yielding non-validity at FrameClass.Base and, via eq_base_of_lt_ztime, at every class strictly below .ZTime, with underivability corollaries through soundness. The Axiom.minFrameClass docstring and both axiom constructor docstrings now cite these theorems alongside the literature, and both Independence/ ledgers count the result. Full lake build and the 43-group module-invariants gate are green, the tree remains sorry-free and axiom-declaration-free, and the four headline results measure [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound], unchanged from the set MainResults.lean pins.
